summary.text: Daryl Deshotel is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 28, representing Avoyelles and St. Landry, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2019 as the year elected.
The page lists Daryl Deshotel with committee assignments including Commerce (Chair).

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Daryl Deshotel's occupation as Business Owner.
It lists Daryl Deshotel's education as B.S., Construction Management, Louisiana State University.
The House member page lists Daryl Deshotel's committee assignments as Commerce (Chair); Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee; House Executive Committee.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
